name: NocoDB
short_description: Open-source Airtable alternative — databases as spreadsheets.
description: NocoDB is an open-source no-code platform that turns any database into a smart spreadsheet interface. Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite and get instant REST APIs, gallery and kanban views, form builders, and team collaboration features.
usecases: Build no-code apps and forms on top of your existing databases.
Collaborate on structured data with a familiar spreadsheet interface.
Auto-generate REST APIs from any database table instantly.
